evidence.finding: Apache-2.0 applies to the Dokka generator and its own resources; subordinate npm/Prism licences remain MIT or Apache-2.0 and are recorded in the resource closure.
Pinned npm package archives/integrities; actual emitted webpack modules, rather than all build dependencies, determine the admitted resource closure.
Prism 1.29.0 carries its MIT source attribution; the exact npm licence and source commit are recorded separately.

licence.scope: Only the reviewed Apache/MIT Dokka documentation resources and their actual emitted dependency closure; embedded OFL fonts and their @font-face declarations are excluded.

attribution: Copyright 2014-2024 JetBrains s.r.o. and Dokka contributors.
The 81 actual included npm components, original copyright holders and full licences are enumerated in the immutable profile and retained documentation notices.

verification.command: python eng/contracts.py pack; python -m unittest discover -s tests/tooling -v
verification.expected: Pinned Dokka generation matches 14017 reviewed generated API members in the three retained Maven modules. The contracts-proto publication suppresses inherited runtime members that Dokka linked across unrelated sibling messages; every prior declared public API marker remains, including Id.getValue and Id.hasValue. The original 42 fixed resources, ten excluded fonts, 81-component licence closure and font transformation remain unchanged from r5. Exact page/resource admission remains required before publication; focused negative cases reject inherited parser aliases and missing API marker fields.

notice.text: Dokka 2.2.0 API documentation includes its Apache-2.0 frontend and the reviewed Apache/MIT dependency closure. Every documentation companion retains all 81 dependency licence texts and the Dokka licence/NOTICE. The ten embedded OFL fonts and their four font-face declarations are excluded; system font fallbacks remain. No JDK Javadoc GPL resource is used. Public API documentation, navigation and offline search remain available. An Apache-2.0 ArcForges CSS correction makes content links readable in the dark theme.
notice.reason: The documentation distributes these upstream resources. Runtime client archives do not contain the Dokka frontend.
